title: svt_usb_configuration family field taxonomy and real enums (config/agent_config/device/host/endpoint)
summary: svt_usb_configuration (svt_usb_configuration.sv:189, extends svt_configuration, 31667 lines, the largest class in the VIP) is the master protocol-knob registry shared by every layer (ESS/SS/USB2.0/SSIC/OTG). Real, verified top-level enums: vip_generation_enum {GEN_A, GEN_B, GEN_T} -- doc comment explicitly deprecates GEN_A (USB3.0-only internal model, max 5Gb/s, 'limited bug fixes and no enhancements') in favor of GEN_B (USB3.1 Enhanced SuperSpeed Gen1/Gen2 + USB2.0, actively maintained); GEN_T = USB4 Gen-T adapter/tunneling mode. usb_ss_signal_interface_enum {USB_SS_CHANNEL, USB_SS_TLM, PIPE3_IF, USB_SS_SERIAL_IF, SSIC_RMMI_IF, SSIC_SERIAL_IF, USB_SSIC_CHANNEL, USB_SSIC_TLM, PIPE4_IF, NO_SS_IF}. usb_adapter_signal_interface_enum {NO_ADAPTER, USB4_ADAPTER_TLM, USB4_ADAPTER_IF, USB4_IIP_CUSTOM_ADAPTER_IF, USB4_ADAPTER_CHANNEL}. usb_20_signal_interface_enum {USB_20_CHANNEL, USB_20_TLM, UTMI_IF, ULPI_IF, USB_20_HSIC_IF, USB_20_SERIAL_IF, USB_20_EUSB2_IF, NO_20_IF}. component_subtype_enum {PHY, MAC}. ssic_profile_enum: 18 named G{1,2,3}{A,B}_L{1,2,4} SSIC profiles. ss_ping_timeout_terminate_style_enum {SS_PING_TIMEOUT_TERMINATE_ALL_ISOC_EPS, SS_PING_TIMEOUT_TERMINATE_EP_WHICH_RCVD_PKT, SS_PING_TIMEOUT_REQUIRE_LPF_ALL_ISOC_EPS} tied directly to svt_usb_protocol_service::service_type==CMD / protocol_command_type==USB_SEND_DEFERRED_PACKETS. lpm_type_enum {LPM_NORMAL, LPM_DEEP, LPM_SHALLOW}. Field taxonomy (representative, verified, not exhaustive -- hundreds of knobs total): role/topology bits is_downstream/is_upstream[_phy] gated by `ifdef SVT_USB_ENABLE_HUB_MODE; USB4-tunneling enables (enable_usb4_adapter_mode_symbol_set_scheduling_delay etc., enable_usb32_feature); dozens of per-LTSSM-substate int timing counters each named exactly after and defaulted from an `SVT_USB_<SAME_NAME> macro (e.g. polling_lfps_received_count, polling_rxeq_tseq_count, hot_reset_active_sent_idle_count, recovery_configuration_received_ts2_count) -- every LTSSM timing value is independently overridable both via macro and live config field; rand svt_usb_types::ltssm_state_enum usb_ss_initial_ltssm_state=U0 lets a test start the link FSM mid-training; U1/U2 power-mgmt enables and timeouts; scores of coverage on/off switches (enable_rptr_chk_cov/_pass_cov/_fail_cov, enable_ltssm_coverage_for_active_agent); compliance/CTS knobs (loopback_cts_compliant, cts_compliance_loopback_tx_iterations); usb_ss_data_scramble=1 / enable_eusb2v2_data_scramble=1 (scrambling on by default). svt_usb_agent_configuration (svt_usb_agent_configuration.sv:107) extends svt_usb_configuration directly, adding agent-specific: is_active=1, enable_monitor=1, base/concurrent_*_gen_autostart, enable_{ssic_phys,phys_base,phys_concurrent,phys_adapter_base,link_base,link_concurrent,prot}_exceptions bitmasks (each defaulted from an SVT_USB_NO_*_EXCEPTIONS macro), enable_{link,prot,phys}_chk[_cov/_pass_cov/_fail_cov], enable_debug_ports/_pl_debug_ports, port_num[3:0], wait_for_dut_ltssm. It also references (used-but-not-locally-declared-in-cleartext) svt_usb_agent_configuration::stack_layer_enum (param type for get_layer_event_pool) and ::dut_model_enum with members RTL, VIP, NOT_APPLICABLE (confirmed via doc-comment quotes in svt_usb_system_virtual_sequencer). svt_usb_device_configuration (svt_usb_device_configuration.sv:27, extends svt_configuration directly, a SIBLING not a child of agent_configuration) fields map 1:1 to USB Device Descriptor + BOS/USB3 capability fields: cable_id, port_id[7:0], device_address[6:0], connected_bus_speed (svt_usb_types::speed_enum), connected_num_lanes (LANE_SUPPORT_1/2), endpoint_cfg[$] (svt_usb_endpoint_configuration queue), num_endpoints, max_packet_size_0=512, route_string_port[5] (per-tier USB3 hub routing string), connected_hub_device_address, xhci_slot_context_hub/xhci_slot_context_number_of_ports (direct xHCI Slot Context mirroring), lpm_capable, remote_wakeup_capable, functionality_support (speed_enum), u1_dev_exit_lat/u2_dev_exit_lat, max_power, ltm_capable, low_speed_capable/full_speed_capable/high_speed_capable/five_gbs_speed_capable, self_powered_capable. svt_usb_endpoint_configuration (svt_usb_endpoint_configuration.sv:19, sibling, extends svt_configuration) maps 1:1 to Endpoint Descriptor + SS/SSP Endpoint Companion fields: speed, ep_number, direction (ep_direction_enum IN/OUT), ep_type (CONTROL/BULK/INTERRUPT/ISOCHRONOUS), max_retry_due_to_{nak,stall,timeout,error}, host_xfer_attempts_after_stall=-1, isoc_mult (isoc_mult_enum, SS burst multiplier), max_burst_size, max_burst_extension, max_packet_size (default SVT_USB_SS_CONTROL_MAX_PACKET_SIZE), interval (bInterval-equivalent), intr_mult (intr_mult_enum), num_psid_values (bulk-streams PSID count, default SVT_USB_MAX_NUM_PSID_VALUES), supports_ustreams, ssp_bytes_per_interval, pp_bit_mode (svt_usb_types::pp_bit_mode_enum). svt_usb_host_configuration (svt_usb_host_configuration.sv:14, sibling, extends svt_configuration) confirmed to exist; not yet field-walked in this pass (follow-on target).
